name: mag-empty.try3
prompt:
Premium science-fiction game interface art for Last Line: dark smoked glass over graphite steel, fine white-gold filigree lines, thin constellation lines and small glyph marks at the corners, electric cyan and orange-gold light accents, a faint inner glow. Crisp, finished and richly detailed like the interface of a top commercial sci-fi action game, with clean bevels and sharp edges, readable at small size. Shown flat and straight on, no perspective, no scenery. No text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark.

KIND PART: One small premium raster interface hardware part. Compact tangible hard-surface construction, broad readable material planes, carefully finished bevels, restrained microdetail. The object itself is the complete subject, without any surrounding frame, badge, border, scene or cast shadow. Orthographic front view, straight on. No text, letters, numbers, logo or signature. The large unmarked surfaces and simple silhouette remain readable at 8 to 24 pixels.

Use the supplied mag-full as exact silhouette and proportion reference; use mag-empty.try2 as an edit target for the cavity. Preserve the identical narrow tall outline, top and bottom caps, bevel profile, centred placement and transparent margins. Paint a continuous sharply luminous white-gold rim on the left and right edges and across the two ends of the recessed groove. These continuous bevels are brighter and thicker than the original empty cell, clearly enclosing a dark slot at 10-pixel canvas size. Keep the larger outer top and bottom end caps very dark graphite, with only a slim gold outer chamfer. Make the cavity an almost black empty recess, occupying 65 percent of the inner width. A very faint dark-cyan inner reflection only. The only broad bright areas are the continuous bevels enclosing the slot. Keep all cavity pixels opaque, with flat near-black material. Use enough black negative material to balance the bright rim: mean visible-object sRGB luma near 0.34, compared with 0.647 for accepted mag-full. The full and empty silhouettes remain identical. Elegant finished metal and precise contained highlights.

Background: genuine transparent RGBA; square 1024 canvas, longest object side 70 percent, centrally aligned. Crisp hard contour with all illumination within opaque material.

name: reduced-motion.c2-try2
prompt:
Premium science-fiction game interface art for Last Line: dark smoked glass over graphite steel, fine white-gold filigree lines, thin constellation lines and small glyph marks at the corners, electric cyan and orange-gold light accents, a faint inner glow. Crisp, finished and richly detailed like the interface of a top commercial sci-fi action game, with clean bevels and sharp edges, readable at small size. Shown flat and straight on, no perspective, no scenery. No text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark.

KIND — ICON: A single standalone painted raster HUD icon. One bold coherent silhouette with broad luminous material faces and restrained detail, legible at 20 pixels. Actual crafted object, dimensional bevels and subtle material wear, front view. The requested hardware housing or physical crest belongs to the subject; keep the exterior canvas empty. No writing, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Square 1024 x 1024 canvas. The complete subject including attached accents spans 70 percent of the canvas on its longest side and is precisely centred, with at least 15 percent clear margin on every side. Hard clean cutout contour, opaque solid object and crisp contained light; generous open negative spaces between separate features. Bright ivory-white-gold faces and cyan signal details against graphite recesses give strong small-size luminance contrast. Use just enough filigree to match the premium Lightbearer UI; group it into a few large readable shapes.

Subject: Reduced motion. Refine the supplied orb-and-clamp image while preserving its clear circular body with three left-side trails. The solid cyan orb has smooth opaque blue enamel and broad luminous faces. The very thick ivory-white-gold damping ring wraps around its upper and lower sides, with broad pads visibly holding the orb. Three short, broad horizontal motion traces are physically intercepted by the left side of the damping ring. Render the three traces as calm blunt strips whose cyan COLOR diminishes progressively toward their left ends, from muted cyan to dark blue. Keep each strip fully opaque with a precise hard cutout contour. Their lengths step down. The clamp crosses and arrests the motion strips. Gentle contained orb glow carried entirely by its opaque surface. A restrained, quiet motion-damping icon, distinct from shake with rectangular echoes. Premium dimensional metal, few sparse engravings, legible round mass and damping ring at 20 pixels.

Background: genuine transparent RGBA. Square 1024 canvas, centred subject spans 70 percent of canvas. Every surface of orb, ring and trails is fully opaque. Transparency is confined to the empty canvas and crisp antialiased cutout edges. Contained material illumination.
